about_the_game:
A sweet and adorable brick-breaking game in collaboration with Sugar Conflict!

In Ultimate Sugar Crush!, each character is the personification of a carefully crafted sweet. As you break the blocks, their charming appearances will gradually be revealed, accompanying you on a delightful and refreshing journey.

No matter if you're looking for casual fun or chasing trophies, Ultimate Sugar Crush! delivers a unique brick-breaking experience with dazzling skills and random elements, ensuring every playthrough feels fresh and exciting!

Features

  • Adorable Dessert Girls: Crêpe, Muffin, Pudding, Cream Puff, and Marshmallow Parfait come to life as cute anthropomorphic girls.

  • Satisfying Brick-Breaking Action: Smash blocks, combos, and thrill of chain reactions.

  • Fun & Unique Skills: Bombs, paddles, and other special abilities empower the style and strategy to the gameplay.

  • Randomized Challenges: Block positions change each time you enter a stage, giving you a new experience with every play.

  • Sweet visual treat: Adorable Japanese-inspired art style that makes every moment both exciting and heartwarming.

content_descriptors.notes: Some scenes in the game will appear bare and sexually suggestive content that is not suitable for minors; Please decide whether to play or not.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (Quad Core) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable GPU (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better / Apple Silicon GPU)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio device
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 (Ventura) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 / M2 / M3, or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon GPU / AMD Radeon Pro or better
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio device
